summary: Iteration 33 — 'Continue Where You Left Off' dashboard card verified end-to-end on backend, web, and mobile. Backend GET /api/me/continue returns both last_scene and active_party for the admin (Ancient Market Square / The Ashen Vanguard) and nulls for a freshly-seeded empty-state user. Web shows the continue-card with a working continue-rp-link (already verified by main agent) and continue-party-link that navigates to /parties/<id> and renders the party page. Mobile shows the dashboard-continue-card with both dashboard-continue-rp (already verified by main agent) and dashboard-continue-party rows; tapping the party row navigates to /realm/party?id=<id> and renders 'The Ashen Vanguard'. On both surfaces the card is hidden entirely for a user with no RP and no party. Cross-platform parity holds. No blocking issues. Two pre-existing RN-Web console warnings persist ('shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents') — same as iteration_32, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking, appears on any screen with elevated cards. Same warning class as the pointerEvents one from iteration_32.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; also flagged in iteration_32.

action_items: (Optional cleanup, non-blocking) Migrate mobile styles off the deprecated `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN-Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_continue_state: uses correct Mongo indexes (user_id + status filter on parties, user_id on location_rp) and correctly excludes accepted quests per spec.
server.py: last_scene.location_name / city are resolved from the locations collection with graceful title-casing fallback if the location doc is missing — safe.

server.py: active_party query correctly restricts status to ['recruiting','active'] and sorts by created_at desc; consider sorting by an 'updated_at' field in the future if a user has multiple active parties (currently returns the most-recently-created, not the most-recently-touched).
frontend Dashboard.js: card is only rendered when (last_scene || active_party) — matches spec ('hidden entirely for empty state'). Verified live.

mobile dashboard.tsx: same conditional (`scene || party`) — matches. Party row navigates via router.push({pathname:'/(tabs)/realm/party', params:{id}}) — resolves to /realm/party?id=<uuid> on RN-Web, matches expected deep link.
No hardcoded URLs, no _id leak, no ObjectId in response — clean.
